title: Linnik for seven-free primes
plain: Show the smallest seven-free prime in an arithmetic progression is at most a fixed power of the modulus.
math: Prove there is $C$ such that for every $q$ and $(a,q)=1$ (with $10\nmid q$-compatibility conditions) there is a 7-free prime $p\equiv a\ (q)$, $p\le q^C$.
